integrity: The argument is fully algebraic for all totally unimodular full-row-rank matrices. The included exact-integer checker reproduces 771 small-graph cases, cube examples, and a cographic example without establishing the infinite assertion computationally.
scientific_limitations: The exact gcd controls minimum 2-adic valuation, not smallest nonzero absolute multiplier, Fourier nullity or full spectrum; it does not assert a converse zero-free criterion. Priority checking is bounded; one earlier related source was available only as an abstract. Independent external validation was not performed.
title: Bicycle dimension gives the exact Walsh divisibility of regular-matroid bases
